title: Study Lifecycle Monitor
summary: An operational health console for a synthetic portfolio of studies, from protocol to clinical study report: a risk heatmap scored on timeline, data, TLF and resource, ranked early-warning signals, the portfolio's open-query trend, and each study's milestones and TLF production funnel. The scoring is transparent, so a what-if on one study's open queries or double programming moves its risk where you can see it. Study-level operations data only, with no participant data.
try: Click a row of the heatmap, or pick a study in the sidebar, to open its milestone track and TLF funnel.
Drag Open queries up for the selected study and watch its Data score, the At risk count and the signals change.
For a study in DB Lock or Reporting, lower Double-programmed % below 60: a double-programming lag signal appears, and Reset to data undoes the what-if.
